release_read.basis: Adj EBITDA $3.9m vs a $3.4-3.6m guide (+11% vs midpoint) and adj EPS $0.30 vs $0.26-0.28 guide, FY adj EBITDA raised to $13.4-13.6m from >= $12.7m and Q4 run-rate to >$17m from >$15m, the same EBITDA-raise pattern that moved +37.5% in August; tempered by revenue $11.0m slightly under the $11.13-11.2m street, FY revenue only narrowed, and a +15% five-day run-up into the print.

release.headline: AudioEye Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Results

vs_bar.consensus_source: Benzinga $0.26 / MarketBeat $0.23 (via hunt); Nasdaq forecast fallback $0.16

key_line.metric: adj EBITDA beat and FY EBITDA raise
key_line.detail: Q3 adj EBITDA $3.9m (35% margin) vs $3.4-3.6m guide; FY adj EBITDA $13.4-13.6m vs prior >= $12.7m; Q4 annualised adj EBITDA >$17m vs prior >$15m exit run-rate; GAAP net income $1.0m ($0.08). ARR $43.3m vs $42.3m in June (+$1.0m, in line with trend).

guidance.detail: EBITDA and EPS raised (FY adj EPS >= $1.04 vs >= $0.98); FY revenue narrowed to $43.6-43.8m from $43.5-44.0m (midpoint -$0.05m, maintained); Q4 revenue $11.4-11.6m, Q4 adj EBITDA $4.2-4.4m, adj EPS $0.32-0.33.

call.detail: Call held last night; no transcript read yet.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a repeat EBITDA beat over the company guide plus a buyback read-through; EBITDA beat by ~11% and was raised, revenue landed inside guide but under the street, as the hunt expected.

expected.open_lag_note: Provisional before the tape: amc print with a full night to be read, gaps tend to fade in the first half hour.
